whyTrust.title: Why you can trust us
whyTrust.verifiedBody: We check the doctor's medical registration number and documents, and the doctor signs our agreement. Only then do we show the A-CureXpress Verified badge.
whyTrust.registeredBody: Our team approved the profile, but full verification is not complete yet. We never show both labels the same way.
whyTrust.licencesBody: Medical shops and pharmacies hold their own licences. We check them during approval and when they expire.
whyTrust.privacyBody: Only you and your treating doctor can see your health records. Wider sharing needs your consent.
whyTrust.paymentsBody: Payments are confirmed on our servers with the payment provider, never only in your browser.
whyTrust.scopeNote: Verification checks credentials and documents. It does not guarantee a clinical outcome.
whyTrust.cta: Read how we keep you safe

q1.q: Do I need to log in to browse doctors?
q1.a: No. You can browse doctors, clinics and specialities without an account. We ask you to log in only when you book.

q2.q: What is the difference between Verified and Registered?
q2.a: A Verified doctor has had their registration and documents checked and has signed our agreement. A Registered doctor has an approved profile but has not completed full verification yet.

q3.q: Can I consult a doctor online?
q3.a: Yes, with doctors who have turned on online consultations. Each doctor's profile shows whether they offer online, clinic visits or both.

q4.q: How do I cancel or reschedule a booking?
q4.a: You will see the cancellation and reschedule rules before you confirm. You can change a booking from My appointments once booking opens.

q5.a: Your records are visible only to you and your treating doctor. Wider sharing needs your recorded consent.

q6.a: No. In an emergency call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
